sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the sentiment score reflects how stretched or depressed market expectations are heading into the print. The document describes a specific, already-stated growth target for ads revenue (roughly double YoY) that the market will measure the print against, implying a high bar. There is no mention of depressed expectations or a beaten-down valuation; instead, the bar appears elevated, raising the risk of a negative surprise even on decent results. Therefore, the score is slightly negative.
